annotations.title: Estimate supply current and battery life

description: Estimate a system's supply current and battery life (not thermal power dissipation) from parts your account extracted: total active current (mA), total standby current (uA), a breakdown per part and battery life on six standard batteries, as the DatasheetVend Workbench POWER tab computes it. Reads ONLY the jobs you pass: include each part's power_battery run, and its pinout run (it sets the role a fallback figure rests on). Active is the highest stated active row, standby the deepest stated low-power row (a best case), typical where stated and max otherwise. A part with no stated current gets a generic figure for its role, flagged is_estimated, and the totals then include estimates: read `coverage` (chips_active_stated of chips_on_bench, chips_standby_stated) before you repeat a number. Battery life assumes 5% active / 95% standby, nominal capacity, no derating or self-discharge. system_voltage_v is echoed, never used to rescale a current. A job whose outputs are gone is refused. Deterministic: runs DatasheetVend's checks in code, calls no model and extracts nothing. Costs no credits. Needs a DatasheetVend API key.

job_ids.description: 1-12 extraction jobs in your account: each part's power_battery run, and its pinout run.

system_voltage_v.description: The bench supply rail, echoed in the answer (currents are not rescaled). Default 3.3.
